ops.body: Closed 2026-10-14 with two criteria superseded by the design root approved. The identity is a compile-time constant in the core (rust/crates/core/build.rs -> BUILD_IDENTITY) that the store binds into FactOrigin.engine, so it is by construction the identity of the loaded code and no file is read. No _native getter was added (criterion 1 as worded): nothing outside the store needs the value, and root's exact-head review asked for none. No replace-the-file test exists (criterion 2): there is no file read left to race; core_carries_a_build_identity and the 'a different engine build' rejection case in snapshot_prepared_disk cover the binding. Released as cc-transcript 14.43.0; consumer merged as captain-hook d7a8928.
